sequential_dependency.intermediate: Per-command route records containing target color, effective hand, initial direction, ordered cursor positions, and geometry-derived bounce transitions.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Decode the four header target colors and turn hands, locate the cyan cursor and body objects, then trace each command through target arrival and any blocker bounce.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Discard the header and paint color 8 over every cursor footprint named by the route records, leaving all other body cells unchanged.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Changing A’s decoded hands changes route positions after target arrival; B paints those positions directly, so the final output changes while the input and paint stage stay fixed.

parametric_work.summary: Default turn_mode=header exactly reproduces the official parent; turn_mode=reverse swaps decoded header hands on identical inputs. Two demonstrations identify the setting and every episode carries four distinct privately ordered queries.

target.summary: Built a complete native family for the header-programmed cyan-cursor parent, including a general protected-Racket rule, standalone deterministic generator, two matched-input turn-hand settings, private sequential query export, focused tests, finite-rival audit, adversarial export checks, and source-bound causal witness.
